outcome: Comorbidities (gestational hypertension, chronic hypertension, hypothyroidism, obesity, lipid abnormalities)
cohort: 139 women with GDM and age- and parity-matched controls with normal glucose tolerance
finding: Gestational diabetes is associated with various comorbidities, high insulin requirement, and increased risks of maternal and neonatal complications, but optimal glycemic control can mitigate adverse neonatal outcomes.
